design.selection: First256 with frozen B0 raw K1 surprisal>=1.7 in frozen2048 hash order; all raw attempts must close first. No outcome ranking, missing-item skip, quota shrink or alternate pool.
design.source: Original approved FineMath production native512+16, exact last24prefix reanchor; TEST payloads skipped before JSON.

endpoints.bootstrap: Paired by document;5000 repetitions,seed17. Repeated seeds must be combined per document before treating documents as resampling units.
endpoints.pass_rule: Self-reader own-minus-raw AND own-minus-other paired lower95% bounds>0. Oracle-minus-own lower95% bound>0 is remaining headroom; mean empty-minus-raw>=-0.5 is tax qualification. FrozenB0-reader contrasts reported separately.
endpoints.prospective: Terminal fresh prefix-only own-minus-raw and own-minus-intact-other full16 likelihood, paired document bootstrap. Raw/empty/oracle controls alongside. FrozenB0 and self readers; B0/Cprime/W/T regardless outcome.

execution.closure_limitation: Original capture did not include POSIX session IDs; no explicit whole-SID absence claim. Exact identities/groups, unique inherited TMPDIR, tmux and physical mappings are checked.

finding: A new general high-surprisal developmental panel is frozen; no useful generated-thought claim.

independent_readback.scope: CPU independent reconstruction, no extra model pass.

limitations: DEV is developmental, never finalTEST. Selection uses B0 surprisal, not supplied-note gain or future supervised outcomes.
Existing arithmetic held256 remains unchanged and complementary; no source payload from TEST is decoded.
